data.long_meaning: Baheela is derived from the Arabic word ‘bahilah’ meaning ‘full moon’. In Islamic culture, the moon represents guidance and wisdom. A baby girl named Baheela embodies these virtues. The name Baheela carries the meaning “Full Moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baheela usually hope their child will grow to embody full moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
